description: Looks up one public company by ticker, full company name or SEC CIK number in the live Ctrl Worx Watch List. Returns whether it is on the Watch List, its status, how long the material weakness has been open (years on the Clock and open-since date), the as-of date, its ctrlworx.com page and the SEC filing link. It matches on an exact ticker, CIK or full name. For any other input it returns a list of candidate companies, each with its CIK and status, and no single match.

query.description: Ticker (e.g. CORZ), full company name (e.g. Core Scientific), or SEC CIK number.

name: lookup_company
title: Look up a company on the Ctrl Worx Watch List
